theorems.name: Submission.dorag_ha_mv_deriv_under_integral
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid n)) (h : Euclid n → ℝ) (x : Euclid n) (r R : ℝ) (g : ℝ → ℝ), IsOpen U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 h U → closedBall x R ⊆ U → 0 < r → Continuous g → (∀ t : ℝ, r ^ 2 ≤ t → g t = 0) → ∀ s : ℝ, |s| * r < R → HasDerivAt (fun σ : ℝ => ∫ y : Euclid n, h (x - σ • y) * g (‖y‖ ^ 2)) (-∫ y : Euclid n, fderiv ℝ h (x - s • y) y * g (‖y‖ ^ 2)) s
